scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @mobdaw/server" "npm run dev -w @mobdaw/client --if-present"
scripts.test: npm run test:dsp && npm run build:wasm && npm test -w @mobdaw/server && SLOW=1 npm test -w @mobdaw/client --if-present
scripts.build:wasm: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p engine --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --config engine/.cargo/config.toml && mkdir -p client/src/audio/wasm && cp engine/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/engine.wasm client/src/audio/wasm/engine.wasm
scripts.bench: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p bench --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --config engine/.cargo/config.toml && node engine/bench/run.mjs engine/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/bench.wasm
